findings.title: Action-domain validation permits illegal labels while successful reports hardcode invalid=0

evidence.detail: validate_solve checks label is a string and case IDs are correct, but never requires label in dax/wug; evidence/result are also not validated locally.
The generated output schema treats label as a generic string, so provider structured output does not enforce the legal action set.
Invalid responses are promised as a secondary endpoint; qualification requires zero invalid records.

findings.impact: A future model can emit an out-of-domain action that is treated only as incorrect rather than counted as invalid, and its run may still satisfy aggregate competence thresholds. This did not corrupt S1: all 2,592 archived S1 labels independently checked here are legal.
findings.recommendation: Enforce the legal label enum at both schema and local validation; distinguish invalid action from valid-but-wrong action and report actual invalid counts. Validate any work evidence fields only to the declared contract; do not silently correct reasoning. Add a direct validator unit test, no live inference required.
findings.verification: Isolated extraction/execution of validate_solve accepted four not-a-legal-label strings with valid case IDs; no world/model execution.

findings.title: Prospective archive-sufficiency claims need an equivalence criterion

evidence.detail: If transplant matches continuation, report archive sufficiency; if single controller matches swarm, drop a special swarm advantage claim.
Noninferiority margins are required for stable reward and unaffected-component retention, but matching for portability/single-controller comparisons has no explicit margin or uncertainty criterion.

findings.impact: A small or imprecise pilot can show no detected gap without establishing portable-archive sufficiency or equivalent performance. The draft is unrun and candid about remaining launch blockers, so this is a prospective design clarification rather than a false reported result.
findings.recommendation: Before qualification specify a practically meaningful equivalence/noninferiority margin and interval decision rule for portability/controller comparisons, or label their gaps descriptive and any null result inconclusive. Failure to establish a swarm advantage is already enough to withhold that claim; it does not prove equivalence.

updated_conclusions: The addendum materially improves both completeness and conceptual honesty. Current README/RESULTS explicitly retain v1 as supplied-procedure transmission and link a same-author critical review; no emergence, novelty or multi-generation mentoring claim is defended.

Independent archive recomputation confirms the new mechanistic critique:36 mentoring edges all originate in founders, none in descendants; all72 repair-post solve requests explicitly disclose the new mapping; seed-bank/repair reuse exactly4 binary vectors;648 total S1 solve requests.

There were72 started trajectories:68 completed and4 failed, plus a separate zero-call setup failure. Calls total1697; usage totals1305403 input and425511 output tokens match the results. All306 archive members have a305-entry consistent hash index plus the index file itself.

The v2 selective-continuity proposal is substantially stronger: one flagship scheduling task, acquired payoff-equivalent functional conventions, two replacement waves, stable/partially changed branches, rolling/frozen/transplanted archives, retained-members and single-controller controls, intention-to-treat acquisition failures, and a paired lineage/world estimand. Two further tasks are explicitly deferred extensions.

The draft is not launch-ready and does not pretend to be: transition table, horizon, budgets, schemas, utility weights, margins, sample counts, splits and model versions are named launch blockers. Preserve those blockers and public registration requirements; do not turn the improved story into new evidence.

The dominant remaining implementation risks are unchanged runtime-config binding and reporting failures contaminating execution. The bounded addendum adds an action-domain validation defect and a prospective equivalence-claim clarification; it does not invalidate the archived main-pilot numeric results.
positive_features: The new critical review separates process quality from scientific novelty and labels its own reviewer independence/read depth accurately.
